cases.question: How do I change the altimeter setting?
cases.answer:
To set the altimeter, you need to set the selected altitude in the FIX database. This can be done by any connected FIX client, including an autopilot controller panel or ground-configuration tool. The selected altitude value is then displayed numerically inside or adjacent to the altitude bug box on the altimeter tape. 

First, make sure you have a FIX client connected to the system. Then, set the `ALT_SEL` key in the FIX database to the desired altitude value. This will update the altimeter tape to display the selected altitude bug. 

Note that the altimeter tape is a moving-scale display that shows the present altitude, and it also includes enhancements denoting standard 500- and 1,000-foot increments. The altitude reference bug is recommended to provide acceptable cues.

Then, set the ALT_SEL key in the FIX database to the desired altitude value. This will update the altimeter tape to display the selected altitude bug. To run pyEfis on your laptop, you need to install the dependencies first. You can do this by running the following commands:
